::: {.hero-intro}

I am an Assistant Professor of Behavioral Science at Duke Kunshan University.

Many financial and health decisions involve outcomes that are delayed, uncertain, or both.  I study how people value such outcomes, why younger and older adults value them differently, and how much of that difference reflects their financial circumstances.

:::
